baseline_settings: existing development-selected configurations; loss channels adapted to the matched learner
reference: retained-only objective, zero initialization, L-BFGS followed by strict Newton refinement
gpu: one RTX 3090 per process; E01-E11 use GPU 1; E12 even seeds use GPU 0, odd seeds use GPU 1 after E11 completes
figure_rule: Each experiment owns its figure or table number. Panels contain only that experiment.
matched_comparison: E01 uses identical direct sign and pair-ranking evaluation for the two learner families. The original main table is unchanged.
extrapolation_isolation: E11 preserves original dev_train/dev identities and repartitions only original formal train/test identities. PositionPair and UnseenConstituent separation applies to the fitted selector's formal training combinations.
outcomes: All planned conditions and actual observations enter the report. Evaluation outcomes do not change the protocol.
